notes: Added schema/contract and API error handling stories to complete feature coverage.

GPTR-F-001-S115.title: Allowlist Schema and Contract Definition
GPTR-F-001-S115.description: Define a strict, versioned schema for GPTReader request validation including allowed collections, fields, operators, and limits using Pydantic or equivalent validation models to enforce structure prior to execution.

GPTR-F-001-S116.title: Standardized API Error Response for Rejected Requests
GPTR-F-001-S116.description: Implement consistent error response structure for rejected GPTReader requests, including reason codes (e.g., disallowed_collection, invalid_field, limit_exceeded) and audit-safe messaging.

GPTR-F-001-S117.title: Audit Logging for Enforcement Decisions
GPTR-F-001-S117.description: Extend GPTReader audit logging to capture allowlist enforcement decisions, including rejected queries, violation types, and request metadata for security traceability.
